_about.offer: Prompts that must get an offer for the named skill. When text is given, it is the part of the prompt that must reach the skill.
_about.noOffer: Prompts that must get no offer: questions about a subject, requests for advice, other jobs done on a text, and everyday chat.
_about.knownMisses: Requests the check does not catch today. Listed for the record and not asserted. Move one to offer once the lists catch it.
